GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Niggled early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Outsprinted on rail in straight. # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced in restricted racing room from the entrance to the straight until approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well took sit 3rd 3 Lengths 800m Checked 5th rail 3 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 5th dropped out final 300m Straight # poor run/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m was checked for a number of strides after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & got back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # got a long way back
Jumped well and Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing a length, Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok Went Forward 3 Wide 2nd .5 Lengths 800m took lead .5 Lengths 600m 2nd .5 Lengths Straightened Up 2nd Kept Going Ok Straight # on pace/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m, shifted in and away from a runner and bumped another runner. Thereafter, was steadied when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd & rolled to lead on inside by 3/4L early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & boxed on until faded in last 150m. # Led & weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated he had intended to obtain cover however his mount began well & worked forward to lead the event with minimal effort. Rdr stated his mount was inclined to pull in e&m stages, working hard within itself. Rdr stated mount failed to sprint strongly on straightening before weakening over the final 200m. Rdr stated mounts racing manners in the early and middle stages were to its detriment running out the 1400m journey. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. got up fence turn. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , railed up to 2.5 Lengths fence turning, raiedl into clear running rounding turn, hit Lead 250m, shifted 2-then-3 Wide as it went clear down the running # solid win
Jumped okay & got back to last 7 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground only Two Wide in Straight # never featured
Jumped ok Caught Wide eased couldn't get in had cover though 4 Lengths (800m), coming up even wider before Turn , Under Whip Straight battled ok until late # wide/had cover

Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Leaders heels 2 Lengths 700m, despite tough run took over Straightening Up and had a break, was only claimed late by one that had rail hugging run and he Should Have Won # Should Have Won
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 150m and weakened to the line # weakened last 150m
